description: Header file defining structures, macros, and function prototypes for CJK (Chinese, Japanese, Korean) auto-fitter hinting routines in the FreeType project.

classes.name: AF_CJKBlueRec
classes.description: Structure representing blue zones for CJK glyphs, including reference and undershoot widths, and flags.

classes.name: AF_CJKAxisRec
classes.description: Structure representing axis metrics for CJK font, including scale, delta, widths, and blue zones.

classes.name: AF_CJKMetricsRec
classes.description: Structure encapsulating overall CJK font metrics, including units per em and axis metrics.

methods.name: af_cjk_metrics_init
methods.description: Initializes CJK metrics from a font face.

methods.name: af_cjk_metrics_scale
methods.description: Scales CJK metrics according to a scaler.

methods.name: af_cjk_hints_init
methods.description: Initializes glyph hints for CJK fonts.

methods.name: af_cjk_hints_apply
methods.description: Applies CJK hinting to a glyph outline.

methods.name: af_cjk_metrics_check_digits
methods.description: Checks digit glyphs in CJK metrics.

methods.name: af_cjk_metrics_init_widths
methods.description: Initializes width information for CJK metrics.
